capabilities: Draw pressure-sensitive pen strokes on an infinite canvas
Add rectangles, ellipses, lines, arrows and pattern fills
Select, move, copy and paste drawing elements
Snap shapes to edges, centres and fixed aspect ratios
Save drawings as line-delimited JSON .pencanvas files
extras: Bilingual English/Chinese README; fills render via WebGL with automatic Canvas 2D fallback; unreadable files open read-only and are never overwritten; S Pen side-button eraser is unverified on real hardware.
problem: Obsidian provides no infinite, pressure-sensitive surface for freehand handwriting, shapes, arrows and fills.
summary: Infinite handwriting canvas with pressure-sensitive pen, shapes, arrows and pattern fills, stored as readable JSON files.
